tonight.headline: Rice still has not practised; Myers kicks tonight
body: Bad news first: Rashee Rice did not practise Wednesday and Andy Reid would not commit to him for Thursday, Friday or Sunday (RotoWire/NBC, 14 Oct). Barkley's Wednesday was no better. And the tight-end seat changed again at 23:13 UTC — Strange in, Loveland out — so Jacksonville's Week 7 bye now takes your quarterback, a back, your tight end and your defence.
This week: 117.8 as set against Los Cachanillas' 111.8, ESPN 53%. Jason Myers kicks tonight at Denver, 18:15 — your first lock, and he stays. Nothing else locks before 07:30 Sunday in London.

case.label: Why it is close
case.body: Both of your best bench players are questionable and both lineup calls are coin flips; the 117.8 already counts Tuten and Pickens, the safe sides.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Rice practising Thursday or Friday (he goes in for Pickens if active at 12:55 Sunday); Barkley off Friday's report (he replaces Tuten before 07:30).

case.body: Tuten kicks off at 07:30 in London; Barkley's inactives come at 09:30. Start Barkley on a questionable tag and lose him at 09:30, and the only fallback is Kamara (10.1) — not Tuten.

case.body: Sirianni 'hopeful' (Newsweek, 12 Oct); SI listed him questionable on 13 Oct; absent from the open portion of Wednesday's practice (Inquirer, 14 Oct — not re-confirmed this run). Shipley out for weeks (Schefter, 12 Oct), Bigsby on IR — if Barkley plays the role is his.

whatWentWrong.title: The tight-end seat changed hands again
whatWentWrong.lead: Strange for Loveland at 23:13 UTC — the fourth change at the seat since 3 Oct, and it stacks Jacksonville's Week 7 bye.

case.label: This week
case.body: Harmless: Strange 9.8 against Loveland 8.5 is a coin flip, and Strange has drawn eight targets in each of his last two games (Fantasy Footballers, 11 Oct). Yesterday's brief made the move conditional on Chicago starting Bagent or Keenum; Caleb Williams is expected back.

case.label: The cost
case.body: Week 7: Lawrence, Tuten, Strange and the Jaguars defence are all off. That is the bye plan next Tuesday — and the churn rule now closes the tight-end seat until 21 Oct.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Loveland outscoring Strange in two of Weeks 6, 8 and 9 (archive) — then the swap cost points as well as a seat.
